newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Catholic priest jailed for raping pregnant 15-year-old.
newsitem.headline: Catholic priest jailed for raping pregnant 15-year-old.

text.p: A Zimbabwean Catholic priest has been jailed for seven years for raping a 15-year-old pregnant girl, court officials said on Monday.

They said the supreme court last month dismissed an appeal by Father Robson Ndlovu, 32, rejecting his claim he was seduced by the girl last September before "succumbing to temptation" at a parish post in southwestern Zimbabwe.
The girl, four months pregnant at the time, said the priest had invited her into his bedroom to listen to gospel music.
The court heard also that Ndlovu and Catholic Church authorities had unsuccessfully tried to secure an out of court settlement.
